newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp files for preferred stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp files for preferred stock exchange.

text.p: Citicorp said on Wednesday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission regarding a proposed offer to exchange trust preferred securities for certain series of its outstanding preferred stock.
The proposed offer would apply to Citicorp's preferred stock Series 16, 17, 20, 21, and 22.
The company said that terms for the exchange offer would not be set until the exchange offer commenced, after the registration statement became effective.
